item.title: My Cup
item.description:
My Cup

I have a cup And a desperate need to fill it

I don’t know why tho everyone else wants to just do it

It seems impressive How do they carry the cup without spilling? How do they do the process of filling?

I started finding ways to fill the cup And the options were many I just started to hoard them in Pouring from every jug I found

item.title: Sand Me Down
item.description:
Sand Me Down

Whispered questions

Whispered answers

Can’t pick myself apart

Real me from the cancers

She’s one of the dancers

Wondering where are my manners

Saying without doing is pretending

Gotta be clear, what message I’m sending

Have to, need to

Preserve the beauty of my words

My paragraphs

My sentences

Fixing everything that’s wrong

Guided by a loving hand

Find the strength to sand

Away the uneven land
